links.outcome: LLM answers' accuracy and completeness versus 2023 PDPH consensus guidelines
links.effect: All four models 100% accurate (10/10); incompleteness (omission of critical guideline content) was 80% ChatGPT-4o, 70% DeepSeek-R1, 60% ChatGPT-4o mini and DeepSeek-V3 (p = 0.729).
links.quote: Though largely accurate, their responses achieve only 60-80% completeness relative to medical guidelines.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and benchmarks the accuracy and completeness of several LLMs (ChatGPT and DeepSeek models) against international consensus guidelines for post-dural puncture headache management.
